agent-instructions.objective: Serve one drink to a customer. Take the order, confirm the customer has paid, then dispense the drink through the espresso machine. Never dispense a drink that has not been paid for, and never dispense before an order has been taken.

verifiable-behavior.fizzbee:
--- deadlock_detection: false liveness: "false" options: max_concurrent_actions: 1 ---
# ---- State ---- action Init: order_taken = False payment_confirmed = False drink_dispensed = False
# ---- Take the customer's order ---- atomic action TakeOrder: require not order_taken order_taken = True
# ---- Confirm payment (models success/failure) ---- atomic action ConfirmPayment: require order_taken require not payment_confirmed payment_confirmed = oneof [True, False]
# ---- Dispense the drink (models machine success/failure) ---- atomic action DispenseDrink: require order_taken require payment_confirmed require not drink_dispensed drink_dispensed = oneof [True, False]
# ---- Invariants (must always hold) ---- # A drink is never dispensed before payment is confirmed. always assertion NoDispenseBeforePayment: return (not drink_dispensed) or payment_confirmed
# A drink is never dispensed without an order. always assertion NoDispenseWithoutOrder: return (not drink_dispensed) or order_taken

promises.description: Takes a drink order, confirms payment, and dispenses the drink via the espresso machine. Never dispenses before payment is confirmed.

offer.body: Serve one drink the customer ordered, dispensed only after payment is confirmed.
A drink is never dispensed before payment is confirmed. This exterior claim is supported by the machine service's independent refusal of an unpaid dispense (NoDispenseBeforePayment).

use.body: The customer's payment settles the payment_confirmed condition before any drink is dispensed.
The espresso machine brews the drink on request; the barista relays its result and never brews on its own.

step-guidance.binding: Call take_order with the drink the customer asked for. Repeat the order back so the customer can correct it before paying.
Call confirm_payment. Do NOT dispense anything until it returns success. If payment fails, tell the customer and stop — this is a hard gate.
Only after payment is confirmed, call dispense_drink, which asks the espresso machine to brew and pour. Relay the machine's result to the customer verbatim, including any failure.

agent-instructions.enforcement: The service layer MUST enforce these independently of the model: dispense_drink refuses unless payment_confirmed is true. dispense_drink refuses unless an order has been taken.

responses.order-taken: Got it — one [drink]. That'll be [amount]. Ready to pay?
responses.payment-required: I can't start your [drink] until payment goes through. Want to try again?
responses.error: Something went wrong with the machine: [error]. No charge stands for an undelivered drink.
